resources.string: Tasks, projects, events, birthdays, remind-me items and reminder settings (and habits later) are copied to your private Supabase project. Notes, journal, body data, photos, voice notes and the reminder history never leave this phone.
Signing in is optional. Everything works without it.
Signing out keeps everything on this phone.
Almost done: open the email Supabase sent to %1$s and tap the link, then come back and sign in. (The page it opens may look broken; that is fine, the account is confirmed.)
This build has no Supabase settings, so sync is off. Everything else works.
That does not look like an email address.
The password needs at least %1$d characters.
Your email is not confirmed yet. Open the link in the email from Supabase, then sign in again.
An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
That password is too weak. Use a longer one with letters and numbers.
Supabase did not accept this email address.
Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
No internet connection. Try again when you are online; the app keeps working offline.
Something went wrong on the Supabase side. Try again later.
Sync started. It runs as soon as there is internet.
The last try had no internet. It syncs by itself once you are online.
Your sign-in expired. Sign out and sign in again.
The Supabase project is paused (free projects pause after about a week without use). Open the Supabase dashboard and restore it; the app keeps working meanwhile.
Some changes were refused by the server and stay on this phone. They are kept and tried again.
Sync failed for an unknown reason. It tries again later.
This removes your tasks, events and reminders from Supabase. Everything on this phone stays. You will be signed out so nothing uploads again.
This cannot be undone. Any other phone signed in to this account loses its cloud copy too.
Could not delete the cloud data. Check the internet and try again.
